tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed chog bzhugs so// maṇḍal bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po me 'bar bzhin pa'i sa gzhi'i steng du/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ las kyi rlung nag 'tshub ma'i nang du/ rakta'i rgya mtsho chen po lbu ba'i rlabs phreng phyogs bcur 'khrigs pa/ nya dang / rus sbal dang / chu srin la sogs pa gdug pa'i srog chags kyis yongs su gang ba'i chu gter chen po'i dbus su/ keng rus kyi ri rab la stag gzig dom/ dred la sogs pa gcan gzan du ma ngar sgra sgrog pa/ dug shing la sogs pa'i shing dang / lo ma dang me tog dang / 'bras bu nag po tsher ma can gyis gang ba/ chu klung gi tshogs gya gyur 'bab cing / khwa dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod la sogs pa dgra bgegs kyi srog la rngam zhing sha khrag dang rgyu ma 'dren pa'i bya dang / srin po dang / ro dang / ro langs la sogs pa du mas gang ba'i dur khrod chen pos yongs su bskor ba'i nang du/ gshin rje'i pho brang nag po phyi nas me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba'i thod pa'i lcags mkhar zlum po sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la ro dang ro langs gar byed pa/ thod skam gyi pha gu dang / kem rus kyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'chang ba/ tsitta dmar po'i shar bu dang / dung chen gyi mda' yab kyi steng du mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du tsitta rin po che'i tog gi mtshan pa/ de'i nang du g.yang gzhi'i bla bre/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi nang kun tu khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i nang gi dbus su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte ba dang rtsibs rnams dang sgo bzhir raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/

dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du maṃ las ma he nag po rab tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog nag po drag la rngam pa/ ma he khros pa'i zhal gdengs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma dang / sma ra dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas khro bo'i rdo rje gdengs pas mtshan pa'i thod dbyug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa nag po 'phen zhing 'debs pa/ thod skam gyis dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon gyis do shal dang / sbrul nag gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du hrīḥlas rtse gsum hrīḥs mtshan pa las/ 'chi bdag chen po tsā muṇḍi sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rtse gsum dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ nu ma 'phyang zhing lto ba che ba/ ba glang gi ko rlon gyon zhing / rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi gdan rnams la/ shar du ya ba ti seng ge la zhon pa 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lhor phya bsang g.yu 'brug la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu smig pa mkha' lding la zhon pa gsal shing 'dzin pa/ byang du ral pa tshar dgu chu srin la zhon pa mdung thung 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po/ 'jigs shing mi sdug pa'i cha byad can/ mtshams kyi gdan rnams kyi steng du/ shar lhor ka la ra tri dre'u rta la zhon pa las kyi me long 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i gung la rgyu ba/ lho nub tu gsod byed nag mo bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/

nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin zhing nyi ma'i zer la rgyug pa/ nub byang du nag mo chen mo rlung nag 'tshub ma la zhon pa mtshon gyi gru gu 'dzin zhing nam gyi gung la rgyug pa/ byang shar du nam gru chen mo chu bya nag mo la zhon pa/ bdud kyi khram shing 'dzin zhing / nam gyi tho rangs rgyug pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar nag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang / g.yon thams cad sho rde'u dkar nag thogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du shar du ya ma da ti stag la zhon pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor kā la pa sha gzig la zhon pa zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ya ma dāṇḍi dom la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ byang du ya ma daṃṣṭi dred la zhon pa mche ba 'dzin pa bzhi ka'ang sku mdog dkar po 'jigs shing mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ lha ma srin sde brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ de thams can kyi dpral bar oṃ zhes sogs jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang pas mdzad pa'i gtor chog bzhin bya'o/ /'di yang sa skya lo tsās bris// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
